name: Find The Gravity Falls [125]
desc:
💎If you enjoy this game Please, Like And Favorite to Support us💎


💚Welcome to Find The Gravity Falls💚


🖼️Explore Gravity Falls Oregon and its hidden mysteries and secrets, The goal is to collect and find all the Gravity Falls to complete your index.🖼️


❓This game was made in honor of the beautiful series ''Gravity Falls'' which ended after 2 amazing seasons.❓


⚠️Join The Community for Suggestions or Reports About Game Breaking Bugs/Glitches⚠️

scripts.title: Instant 125 finds
scripts.script:
-- //
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- //
local character = player.Character

-- //
local GravityFalls = workspace:WaitForChild("GravityFalls")

local args = {
	"STANFORD",
	"Fall56"
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("remoteEvents"):WaitForChild("PasswordEntered"):FireServer(unpack(args))


for _, part in ipairs(GravityFalls:GetChildren()) do
if part:IsA("Part") then
while task.wait() do
character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(part.CFrame)
break
end
end
end
